text:
Filip Forsberg has 26 points in 24 games, a four-game point streak, and CBS Sports had him on pace for another 90-point season. Nashville is winning more than it is losing over his last ten, and nine of his points have come on the power play.

Our numbers think the pace is too high. His own shooting is normal, 13.8% against a league average of 13.5%, but the Predators have scored 11.3 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, which pads his total. On-ice luck like that fades, and his ice time has dipped by nearly a minute a night lately. The shot is still a weapon, with a top speed in the 91st percentile on NHL Edge. Evolving-Hockey had him better than his goals last season, so some of this is the bounces evening out in his favour. Our numbers project about 83 points. Watch his assists, which depend most on that on-ice luck.
headline: Forsberg's points come with a luck tax
